commands.command: H=$(node -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("tests/sync/d20-line.json")).line.head)') && T=$(mktemp -d) && git show $H:REFERENCE-AUTHORITY.md > $T/map.md && git show $H:design/environment-map/graph.json > $T/graph.json && O=evidence/D20/ingress-reprove && mkdir -p $O/ingress $O/audit && I='node tests/reference/ingress.mjs' && R=fixtures/reference/ROUTES.json && C=fixtures/reference && G=fixtures/reference/REGISTER.json && $I plan-check --routes $R --map $T/map.md --graph $T/graph.json && $I probe-hosts --routes $R --map $T/map.md --graph $T/graph.json --out $O/ingress/hosts.json && $I verify --routes $R --corpus $C --register $G --out $O/ingress/verify.json && $I verify --routes $R --corpus $C --register $G --refetch --out $O/ingress/refetch.json && $I audit --routes $R --corpus $C --register $G --map $T/map.md --graph $T/graph.json --out $O/audit
